# MathCLI iOS Review Instructions

Review this repository as an iOS SwiftUI calculator app.

- Treat simulator build and XCTest health as the baseline quality bar.
- Check that Calculator, History, Operations, and Settings remain iOS/iPadOS-only.
- Pay close attention to SwiftUI state flow, session-scoped variables/functions, expression parsing, and SwiftData persistence.
- Flag user-visible contrast, readability, accessibility, and touch-target issues.
- Do not recommend macOS, Catalyst, iCloud, widgets, or rendered chart scope unless the PR explicitly targets those future items.
